entities.summary: John Arec Gianelli is an American former professional basketball player. At a height of 6 ft 10 in (2.08 m) tall, he played at the power forward and center positions. He played eight seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) with the New York Knicks, Buffalo Braves, Milwaukee Bucks, and Utah Jazz.
